## Updating and checking

Editorial route metadata lives in `course/catalog.json`; `docs/course_inventory.json` is the generated machine-readable inventory. File discovery and PDF inspection supply all current counts.

```sh
python qa/update_course_inventory.py --write
python qa/update_course_inventory.py
```

Run from the repository root. Python 3.11+ and Poppler `pdfinfo` are required. The check validates generated counts, rendered lecture page labels, local primary-document links and repository/Colab link targets against this checkout. It does not contact remote hosts, authenticate Colab, execute notebooks or validate scientific results.
